18 Geneva hotels, each priced on every booking site we recorded for it. Which booking site listed the lowest prices for Geneva hotels?

The study's count, before taxes and fees: in the September 29, 2026 snapshot, at 13 of the 18 Geneva hotels with a price, the lowest-priced listing was 5% or more below the going rate. Sites with the lowest price there: Agoda at 3, Vio.com at 3, the hotel's own site at 2, Amimir.com at 1, goseek.com at 1, Super.com at 1, Traveluro at 1 and Trip.com at 1. These are the Geneva rows of the study's per-hotel CSV (going_rate_usd and cheapest_usd, before taxes and fees).

On this page, all-in: with taxes and fees as the sites reported them (a resort or destination fee may be extra), at 15 of the 18 hotels listed below a site was 5% or more below the all-in going rate. Sites with the lowest price there: Agoda at 4, Etrip.net at 2, goseek.com at 2, Super.com at 2, the hotel's own site at 2, Traveluro at 2, Vio.com at 2, Amimir.com at 1 and 1 other site at 1 between them (a tie counts for each site). At the other 3, no site was 5% or more below it. The two counts differ: at 2 of the hotels listed below, the all-in prices put the gap on the other side of the 5% line. Taxes and fees at Geneva hotels

At the 11 hotels with both an all-in and a before-tax going rate, taxes and fees, as the booking sites reported them to Google Hotels, added a median of 9% ($18 a night) to the before-tax going rate: from 4% at Hôtel Cornavin to 15% at Green Marmot Capsule Hotel Genève. At 7 hotels no site reported a before-tax price, so their prices are listed prices that may leave out resort or property fees. Our data does not split the gap into taxes and fees.
